card: the occupier director, decision by decision

A fictional campaign on the shipped Guerrilla.Abel template, Remaster data. This is ENGINE OUTPUT: one tri test run of the real game. Every occupier choice, number and position on screen comes from the engine, sampled every 10 s of game time, and the green log lines are quoted from the game log.

It plays only the resistance: which cell takes which zone, and where the player stands. Test levers, each named on screen when used: director tick 10 s (60 in play), wave lead 120 s (600), birth give-up 60 s (600), time acceleration x4 to x8, garrison reserves set to 0 or 2 to stand in for raids, one heat raise to stand in for an ambush, and invulnerable resistance fighters so the held town stays held.
The occupier side was never scripted.

text: Day one. A resistance cell takes Houdan, beside the player's camp. The director still sleeps.
line: OccupierForces: Village taken, 1 distinct town(s) so far

text: A first town only gets the old forty percent roll. This time, no answer.
line: CounterAttack: Village rose; the occupier does not answer (chance 0.40, 0 town(s) taken before)

text: A second cell takes Le Port on the south coast. Four fighters stay to hold it.
line: OccupierForces: Le Port taken, 2 distinct town(s) so far

text: Two towns wake the director. It holds two command tokens and spends them on the hottest towns.
line: OccupierForces: AWAKE after 2 distinct towns (Le Port the latest), 2 token(s)

text: Four men leave the harbour for Le Port. Nothing spawns: the force is a record with a clock.
line: OccupierForces: [op 1] Foot squad (4) from Le Port Harbour to Le Port (4 unit(s), the pool pays 0, lethality 4.00 of 0.00, 0 fighter(s) reported, about 401 s)

text: Four more walk from the Outpost to Houdan. No fighters reported, so it buys the minimum.
line: OccupierForces: [op 2] Foot squad (4) from Outpost to Village (4 unit(s), the pool pays 0, lethality 4.00 of 0.00, 0 fighter(s) reported, about 357 s)

text: Its intel comes only from its own men or from locals. A local in Le Port reports four fighters.
line: OccupierForces: a local in Le Port talked: 4 fighter(s) reported (standing 50)

text: Houdan was left empty. The squad arrives without ever being born and drains the town.
line: CounterAttack: [op 2] arrived abstract at Village (holds the empty target), 2758 m from the player

text: Le Port has defenders, so that fight must be real: the squad is born on its road, unseen, four kilometres away.
line: CounterAttack: [op 1] born for Le Port (spawnReason route) at [8275, 3397], 4183 m from the player

text: Houdan has reverted, but Le Port holds. It rests for thirty minutes and its heat rises.
line: OccupierForces: [op 1] Repelled at Le Port: 4 lost, 0 going home; Le Port rests 1800 s, heat +15

text: Another cell takes the Outpost, then leaves it empty.
line: scenario note: lever: Outpost reserve 0 (an ambush on its relief)

text: A token returns. With no hot target, a strong occupier pushes out: six men head for the quiet Outpost.
line: OccupierForces: [op 3] Push-out: Base retake (foot 6) from Airfield on Outpost (6 unit(s), the pool pays 0, lethality 6.00 of 0.00, 0 fighter(s) reported, about 2420 s)

text: Scripted: a raid leaves the Airfield two men in reserve, and an ambush makes Le Port urgent.
line: scenario note: lever: Airfield reserve 2 (a raid on its barracks)

text: Four reported fighters call for lethality fourteen point four. Urgent, it buys the fastest fit: a truck.
line: OccupierForces: [op 4] Motorized squad (4, Ural) from Le Port Harbour to Le Port (25 unit(s), the pool pays 21, lethality 17.00 of 14.40, 4 fighter(s) reported, about 60 s)

text: But the player watches the harbour road. No point behind the truck is unseen, so it cannot be born.
line: CounterAttack: force on Le Port from Le Port Harbour deferred: no point of its road (behind its progress point) is out of the player's perception; retrying every 30s, its clock stopped, the next base back or cancelled unseen after 60s

text: The next base back? The Compound is on another island, and the Airfield cannot spare the men.
line: CounterAttack: [op 4] Southeast Compound passed over for Le Port: it stands on another landmass

text: So the operation is re-planned as a helicopter insertion.
line: CounterAttack: [op 4] no road to Le Port passes the gate; re-planned as a Mi17 insertion from Airfield (12 units, 127s in the air, on the ledger row)

text: The Mi17 is born airborne, unseen, and lands four hundred metres out, away from the reported fighters.
line: CounterAttack: [op 4] Mi17 with 4 soldier(s) born airborne at [8030, 9905] (100 m up) for Le Port; LZ [7825, 3275] 396 m out, away from the reported fighters

text: Four soldiers get out, the airframe goes home, and the cell repels them too.
line: OccupierForces: [op 4] Repelled at Le Port: 4 lost, 0 going home; Le Port rests 1800 s, heat +15

text: A raid takes the Airfield. Control, sixty percent bases, forty percent towns, drops below three quarters.
line: OccupierForces: Wave 1 (30) inbound to Le Port Harbour, control 0.63 (control threshold; lands in 120 s)

text: Wave one fires: thirty soldiers for the pool, landing at the harbour.
line: OccupierForces: Wave 1 (30) inbound to Le Port Harbour, control 0.63 (control threshold; lands in 120 s)

text: It strikes the densest cluster: the player's headquarters. Six men march on the camp, no token needed.

text: The push-out reaches the Outpost and retakes it.

text: The director wants the Airfield back, but no base can spare the men.
